goal: Verify that a user can register as a Site Host, create a new memo, and successfully navigate to the June 2026 calendar view.
instructions: On the 'Create your account' page, enter 'alice' into the 'Username' field and 'SecureP@ss123!' into the 'Password' field, then click the 'Sign up' button.
In the main dashboard, type 'Remember to review the project timeline tomorrow morning.' into the text input box labeled 'Any thoughts...' and click the 'Save' button.
Click the 'June 2026' button located in the calendar widget to switch the view to the full year calendar.
success_criteria: The user is successfully logged in and the 'Create your account' form is replaced by the main dashboard interface.
The memo 'Remember to review the project timeline tomorrow morning.' is visible in the feed below the input area.
The UI transitions to a full-year calendar view displaying the year '2026' at the top.
The 'June' month grid within the 2026 calendar is visible and the 8th is highlighted.
The previously created memo remains visible in the list below the calendar view.
